answer: Each epoch the protocol posts S, live challenge answers still without a grading seat. An unestablished submit burns S units of this epoch's per-head payout, bound to that key and struck at close. Four seatless answers cost 4. Each extra identity that lands without a seat raises S by one, so the tenth pays 13 and a farm of n pays n*S0 + n(n-1)/2. S cannot be reset, split, or pre-aged: seats are dealt only at a panel redraw. Refuse the burn and the submit is dropped. A delta in S is the meter; a gale of fresh keys moves it; the lotus of one honest submit still pays only posted S.
